summary: Frontend regression + new-pages testing for 6 new pages (Hub, Concentration Games, Glow Up, How To Use, Pricing, Admin). All 13 requested scenarios PASS. Hub replaces Home at /, 13 app-map cards render, all 13 nav links exist and route correctly. Admin gate rejects wrong password and accepts 'awesome2026' to show Articles/Games/Settings tabs; article creation persists to localStorage and appears in list. Concentration Games -> Challenge -> Game -> Number Flash flow works (input accepted). Glow Up wizard renders. How To Use tabs render. Pricing shows 3 tier cards + monthly/annual toggle. Habits, AI Coach, and Focus legacy pages still load fine.

issues: Annual/Monthly toggle has no data-testid — suggest adding 'annual-toggle' and 'monthly-toggle' for future automated tests

Browser console shows 'WebSocket connection to ws://localhost:443/ws failed' due to WDS_SOCKET_PORT=443 in frontend/.env — harmless in the preview container but noisy; can be removed or set to the real port

passed_tests: Hub page loads at / with nav, stats cards (streak/plan/games/level/pages), 14-day focus heatmap, today's quote, and App Map grid with exactly 13 page cards
All 13 desktop nav links present (Hub, Habits, Focus, Games, Glow Up, Feed, Conspiracy, Learn, Community, AI Coach, Pricing, Guide, Admin)
Clicking nav-games routes to /concentration-games and page renders with 3 challenges
Clicking a challenge switches to game list screen
Number Flash game: number flashes, input appears with data-testid='number-flash-input', submit accepted
Glow Up page loads at /glow-up with multi-step wizard (photo drop zone visible on step 0)
How To Use page loads at /how-to-use with feature tabs (guide-tab-*)
Pricing page loads at /pricing with 3 price cards (Free, Pro, Family) and Monthly/Annual toggle
Admin page at /admin shows password gate (admin-login-page)
Wrong password keeps the gate shown; 'awesome2026' unlocks and shows admin-page with Articles/Games/Settings tabs
Create Article flow: + New Article -> fill title+body -> Save -> article appears in list with 'draft' status and persists in localStorage (alu_admin_articles)
action_items: OPTIONAL: Add data-testid='annual-toggle' / 'monthly-toggle' on the Pricing toggle buttons and data-testid='get-started-free' on the Free tier's Link (consistency with other select-* buttons)
OPTIONAL: Remove or correct WDS_SOCKET_PORT=443 in /app/frontend/.env to silence the websocket dev-server error in the browser console
critical_code_review_comments: HubPage.jsx is ~230 lines of heavily inlined styles in one file — readable but would benefit from extracting ALL_PAGES and BADGE_STYLES into a separate module for reuse / testability
AdminPage.jsx holds three tab components (Articles, Games, Settings) in a single 337-line file — consider splitting into /components/admin/*.jsx for maintainability

Admin password is hardcoded client-side (ADMIN_PASS = 'awesome2026' in AdminPage.jsx). Anyone can read it in the bundle. This is a client-only app so it is not a real auth boundary — main agent should document this clearly or gate destructive ops on the backend

Article 'Change Password' flow in SettingsTab is non-functional by design (message says 'session-only') — consider hiding the form or replacing with a 'not available in this build' notice to avoid user confusion

Navigation.jsx uses hard-coded indexes for the mobile bottom nav: [navItems[0], navItems[1], navItems[3], navItems[4], navItems[9]] — if navItems order changes this silently breaks. Prefer picking items by path.

No REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is defined in /app/frontend/.env even though Glow Up docs mention POST /api/glow-up/generate. If/when backend is wired, this env var must be added (matches platform contract).
seed_data_creation: Created one article via UI with title 'TEST_MyArticle' stored in localStorage key 'alu_admin_articles' during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new pages and routes verified. data-testids available: hub-page, page-card-<id> (13 cards), nav-<label>, concentration-games-page, challenge-<id>, game-<id>, number-flash-input/submit/done, glow-up-page, photo-drop-zone, goal-<id>, style-<id>, generate-btn, how-to-use-page, guide-tab-<id>, pricing-page, select-pro/select-family (NOTE: Free tier has NO select-* testid, it uses a plain Link to '/'), admin-login-page, admin-password-input, admin-login-btn, admin-page, admin-tab-articles/games/settings, new-article-btn, article-title-input, article-body-input, save-article-btn. WebSocket dev error 'ws://localhost:443/ws' is harmless.
